summarize.context_builder.label: Context Builder
summarize.context_builder.description: Prepares intake metadata and transcript snippets used by downstream prompts.

summarize.extract_outline.label: Outline Extractor
summarize.extract_outline.description: Derives parties, issues, claims, facts, and legal references as structured JSON.

summarize.build_timeline_seeds.label: Timeline Seeder
summarize.build_timeline_seeds.description: Creates candidate timestamped events that can seed the timeline generator.

summarize.build_entity_hints.label: Entity Mapper
summarize.build_entity_hints.description: Identifies entities and proto-relationships to accelerate graph extraction.

summarize.draft_markdown.label: Summary Drafter
summarize.draft_markdown.description: Produces the layered Markdown case summary referencing transcript timestamps.

summarize.qa_and_finalize.label: QA & Finalize
summarize.qa_and_finalize.description: Validates mandatory sections, computes checksums, and prepares ops metadata.

compose.context_builder.label: Context Builder
compose.context_builder.description: Condenses intake metadata and approved summaries into a case brief for downstream stages.

compose.timeline_builder.label: Timeline Builder
compose.timeline_builder.description: Generates normalized timeline events with timestamp references for compose deliverables.

compose.graph_builder.label: Graph Builder
compose.graph_builder.description: Extracts entities and relationships with evidence links for compose outputs.

compose.client_brief.label: Client Brief Drafter
compose.client_brief.description: Drafts client-facing deliverables at a grade-six reading level with timeline references.

compose.lawyer_brief.label: Lawyer Brief Drafter
compose.lawyer_brief.description: Drafts professional deliverables for counsel, organized by legal issues and evidence.

compose.qa_review.label: QA Reviewer
compose.qa_review.description: Performs compliance checks on compose outputs and records discrepancies for ops logs.

guardian.review.label: Output Guardian
guardian.review.description: Final policy and safety review to block legal advice, interpretation, or form selection.
